tool.name: Feature Selector
tool.description: Feature selection using SequentialFeatureSelector on a single TSV file

param.name: input
param.label: Count Matrix File
param.help: A TSV file containing your count matrix with a header row.

param.name: metadata_file
param.label: Metadata File
param.help: A TSV file containing your metadata with a header row.

param.name: columns_to_drop
param.label: Columns to Drop from Training Data
param.help: Select columns to drop from training data

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of threads to use for SequentialFeatureSelector.

param.name: classifier
param.label: Classifier
param.help: Classifier to use for feature selection.

param.name: tol
param.label: Tolerance
param.help: Tolerance for SequentialFeatureSelector convergence. Lower values mean stricter convergence (default: 0.00001).

tool.help:
This tool performs feature selection on a single TSV file using scikit-learn's `SequentialFeatureSelector`. You can choose from multiple classifiers and configure parameters like tolerance and number of threads.
**Inputs**
- A TSV file with features and a class label column - Name of the class label column - Classifier type - Number of threads - Tolerance (optional)
**Outputs**
- A text file listing the selected feature names - A log file summarizing the run details and timing
